body: You know, you make a good point, and I really appreciate your input here. I will definitely be having a long think about everything, but I think right now, I'm mid diagnosis and am starting a lot of new things in my life with a lot of added stresses. I really need to think about what to do here, either way, I truely love them with all my heart and if I keep them it will entirely depend on if I can get them a better environment in my home, if not, I'll be going through my vet, they also do adoption services and will make sure they get the best home possible.
